title: Loadstone
pitch: Every coin you grab has real mass — your jump arc visibly flattens as you get greedy, so hauling treasure out of the mine is the real boss fight.
howto: Descend the shaft and grab ore — each piece adds weight that saps your run speed and jump height. Climb back and bank at the cart: express jumps when light, ledges when loaded, the grub stairs when heavy. Banked gold buys muscle, boots, satchels and hearts.
controls: Arrows/stick or on-screen pad to move, A/Space/W to jump (release to cut). B/K drops your heaviest item. Walk into the cart to bank, X/J opens the shop.
